question: Should this PR establish the desktop Control UI sidebar width as a persisted 240-400px user preference with stored values below 240px reset to the 258px default?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but it turns an existing dormant browser-local setting into active layout behavior and changes its default/range, so the product contract belongs to maintainers.

options.title: Accept this width contract
options.body: Merge after exact-head CI/review if maintainers want a 240-400px persisted desktop sidebar and accept resetting old below-min stored widths to 258px.

options.title: Preserve old narrow values
options.body: Require a small follow-up before merge that explicitly migrates 200-239px stored values to the nearest supported width and tests that upgrade path.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep or close the PR if persistent sidebar sizing should wait for a broader navigation settings design.

recommendation.title: Accept this width contract
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head CI/review if maintainers want a 240-400px persisted desktop sidebar and accept resetting old below-min stored widths to 258px.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete filed the linked feature issue, owns this PR, and has the strongest recent Control UI sidebar/session history.
